decisions.reason: Report explicitly names PID 42432 (dsh web host) from running-processes.txt as the koffi.node lock holder and explains the native addon stays locked until the process exits, so copyfile fails with EBUSY.

Explains browser refresh only reloads the SPA while host 42432 keeps running, and gives an ordered stop → verify → install → restart sequence in numbered steps without prescribing killing unrelated Node processes.
Grounds in npm-dist-tags.txt: unpinned install follows latest = 0.1.1-rc.2, replacing alpha.4 and effectively downgrading; explicitly states unpinned install never preserves the installed version.

Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version expects alpha.5, and restarts; @alpha only discussed as an alternative.
Advises README authors to never publish unpinned dsh install commands, pin the exact version (or explicit tag), and warns latest can silently downgrade prerelease users; no BAD example is endorsed.
